lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Welcome. Do you have a reservation this evening?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, for three people under Rodriguez.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Excellent. Would you like to hear our specials?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, but first could we have still water for the table?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Of course. Are you ready to order?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I'll have grilled salmon, medium, with seasonal vegetables.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Here is your salmon with fries.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Excuse me, I think there may be a mistake.
